verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo at a sensible size, keeps the orange divider and spaces headline, body, CTA and note evenly. Its flaws are small: the headline runs close to the side edges and there is a little dead space at the bottom. B shrinks the logo until it barely registers and drops the divider, which jams the body copy right under the headline. Its CTA is oversized and nearly touches the canvas edges, the divider line has slid onto 'Ships late June' as a stray underline (a collision), and a large empty band is left at the bottom.
